sections.title: Shopping list like Mealie
items: New in the ⋮ menu of the shopping list: “Check All Items”, “Uncheck All Items” and “Delete Checked” – each with a confirmation, just like in Mealie's web app.
Checking off an item now shows a short message with “Undo”, so an accidental tap is easy to take back.

sections.title: Comments in cooking mode
items: The ⋮ menu in cooking mode now has “Comments”: read the recipe's comments, write new ones or delete your own – without leaving the current step.

sections.title: Recipe Match feedback
items: Recipe Match can now run one of your household's “Post” recipe actions when you keep or skip a recipe – pick them in the new ⋮ menu → Recipe Actions (both off by default).
Undo within 5 seconds cancels the action, so an accidental swipe sends nothing; swipes made offline are sent once you're back online.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Android: the keyboard no longer pops up by itself when you return from a recipe to the recipe list, and scrolling the list or tapping outside the search field now closes it.
